title: Mixing Vault v1 Beta: Multis, Native Mixes & Plugin Chains
changes: Added Multitrack ZIP Uploads: upload audio stem packs up to 500 MB with automatic zip-slip safety, audio validation, and filename sanitization.
Added Isolated Preview Files: each multi lists audio tracks with native web streaming playback and untranscoded full-quality downloads.
Added Native Mixes Section (/mixes): listen to finished community mixes directly in the browser with HTTP Range streaming.
Added Plugin Chains Hub (/plugin-chains): create, filter, view, and share ordered signal chains with settings & notes.
Implemented standardized JSON Schema for chains (PLUGIN-CHAIN-SCHEMA.md) with /api/plugin-chains/[id]/export and import.
Connected Cloudflare R2 object storage with automated 2 GB per-user beta quotas and 9 GB global protection limits.

title: Stem Session Editing & Management
changes: Added ability for session uploaders to edit session details (title, artist, cloud link, format, BPM, key, tags, description) post-approval.
Admin override functionality allowing administrators to edit any submission across the platform.
Integrated edit modals across main cards, detail pages, and personal profile dashboards.

title: Beta Workflow & Redesigned Session Cards
changes: Added dedicated public Beta site deployment pipeline (origin/beta).
Redesigned session cards to place song title & church name at the top with full username visibility.
Promoted search bar to a full-width prominent banner above all stem cards.
Removed artwork dependency for cleaner audio-focused cards.
Simplified sidebar controls to focus strictly on search archive results.

title: Track of the Week Showcase & User Profiles
changes: Added Track of the Week server actions and admin spotlight toggling.
Created dedicated Track of the Week Showcase page (/showcase).
Added user profile pages (/user/[handle]) and clickable handles across the site.

title: Official Launch of the Stem Vault
changes: Public launch of Stem Vault community worship multitrack archive.
Cloud link downloads, audio format badges, and submission workflow.
Built-in bug reporting and community mix challenges.
